2. Objectives are not required
Objectives are suggestions. Antagonists are free to ignore them if they have a preferred or more interesting idea for their course of action.
- For the following antagonists, however, it is highly suggested to follow your objectives: - Nuclear Operatives - Heretics - Cosmic Cult - Blob
Antagonist actions do not have to be nefarious or evil, but should make an effort to influence the story and shift in a meaningful way.
